botsSectionHint: Always-on Bot sessions and the tasks they spawn, run by the app on this computer
noBotsYet: No Bots yet. Click + to create one
deleteBotMessage: Its settings, task records, the Bot session and all task sessions are deleted; clean worktrees are removed and worktrees with uncommitted changes are kept.
removeWorktreeMessage: Deletes the directory {{path}}; the branch {{branch}} is kept.
cleanTaskMessage: Its session history and worktree are deleted and the branch is kept; a worktree with uncommitted changes is kept. The task and its result stay in the list.
cleanTaskKept: The worktree has uncommitted changes and was kept: {{path}}
taskOfOther: A task from {{name}} (managed on another device)
botOfOther: Session of Bot "{{name}}" (runs on another device)
manualHint: You took over; the Bot stays out of it
desktopOnly: Bots can only be set up and run in the desktop app.
name: Name
acceptLabel: What to do with outside events
acceptOffHint: Events from plugins are not passed to the Bot; what you say in the Bot session directly is handled as usual.
acceptObserveHint: The Bot only records what it would do with each event (spawn a task or reply) without doing it; good for watching a new setup for a while.
acceptAutoHint: Requests addressed to the Bot and requests from people on the allow list are handled automatically; everything else is only observed.
ambientRecordHint: Messages that don't mention the Bot, from senders not on the allow list, only go into the event log and don't wake the Bot; it can still read the conversation when it needs to.
ambientDeliverHint: The Bot judges these messages too, for groups where it should spot problems by itself; busy groups cost more tokens.
previewBot: System prompt of the Bot session
notesHint: Long-term notes the Bot keeps for itself, carried over after compaction or into a new session; you can edit them.
pluginsHint: Plugins bring events to Bots (triggers) or send messages out (notifications). Each plugin can have several configurations (several schedules, several Feishu bots…); pick which ones a Bot uses in its settings.
installSource: Or a download URL / a path on this computer
permExec: Commands it may run on this computer
permExecWarn: Commands run outside the sandbox; only install plugins you trust.
permSandbox: Plugins run in a sandbox: no file access, only the hosts listed above; a call running over 5 seconds is cut off, and memory is capped at 64 MB.
uninstallPurge: Uninstall and delete configurations and data
uninstallKeepMessage: The plugin files are deleted; its configurations and data are kept for a reinstall.
uninstallPurgeMessage: The plugin files, all its configurations, their data and outbox are deleted, and Bots stop using those configurations.
wasmUnavailable: The plugin runtime is not running; only built-in plugins are available.
hostNotShared: This computer has no connection to that host
remoteBotsHint: Bots running in the desktop app on {{name}}, controlled from here
chartHint: Events and tasks per day over the last 14 days
restoreMessage: It is saved as a new revision and the Bot uses it from its next turn. Other unsaved changes in the form stay as they are.
newBotTitle: What should this Bot look after?
newBotPlaceholder: A sentence or two: what it watches, what it does, and where it stops to ask you
newBotNote: Event sources, notifications, whether to act on its own: tell it in the chat once it's created. Anything you leave out keeps the defaults (observe only, notify in the app).
changeByTalking: To change its settings, tell the Bot in its session.
onlyThisSession: Only this session (no event sources yet)
approvalBoth: Replies and plugin actions that change things need your approval
approvalWriteOnly: Plugin actions that change things need your approval
approvalAutoOnly: Only applies in auto mode; what you ask for in the session directly needs no approval
activeHoursNote: Plugin events outside these hours wait until they start; routines are not affected
tokenReminderLine: Reminds you once a day past {{n}} tokens; nothing is paused
tokensToday: {{n}} tokens used today by the Bot and its tasks
tokensTodayOf: {{n}} of {{max}} tokens used today by the Bot and its tasks (past it you only get a reminder)
routinesEmpty: No routines yet. Ask in the Bot session, e.g. "every weekday at 9, summarize yesterday's commits".
secretReplaceTitle: The Bot asks for a new secret
secretNote: Saved straight into the plugin configuration on this computer; the Bot never sees it.
secretKeepPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current value
secretSavedOn: Saved the secrets of "{{name}}" and enabled it
noteApprovedReply: You approved the Bot's drafted reply
noteApprovedTool: You approved the Bot's drafted action
noteRejectedReply: You rejected the Bot's drafted reply
noteRejectedTool: You rejected the Bot's drafted action
noteExpiredReply: The Bot's drafted reply expired unapproved
noteExpiredTool: The Bot's drafted action expired unapproved
noteSecretDismissed: You dismissed a request for a secret
noteOwner: Notice from the app to the Bot
noteHandback: You handed the task back to the Bot
noteHandbackEvent: The task handed a message back to the Bot
noteFollowUp: A follow-up went to the task handling it
changeComputerUse: allowing tasks to use the desktop
